en.headline: Immersive space exhibition Fly Me to the Moon opens at K11 MUSEA from 2 October
en.dek: The multi-sensory show invites visitors on a 380,000-kilometre journey to the moon with panoramic projections, lunar habitat designs and outdoor installations along Victoria Harbour.
body: An immersive space exhibition titled Fly Me to the Moon – A 380,000 km Odyssey will open on 2 October at K11 MUSEA in Tsim Sha Tsui and run until 22 November.

Organised by IOIO Studio, the exhibition centres on the moon as humanity’s next frontier. Visitors experience panoramic immersion simulating the voyage, future lunar living habitats, national-level aerospace models and interactive design elements powered by advanced technology.

Ticketed indoor areas occupy the sixth-floor exhibition hall and sculpture park. Outdoor aerospace-themed installations are free to view at Avenue of Stars, Salisbury Garden and the K11 MUSEA ground level, turning the harbourfront into a cosmic public space.
Standard admission is HK$200 for ages 12 and above and HK$175 for children under 12. Tickets are available through Ticketflap and at the door. Opening hours are 10am to 9pm daily.

zh.headline: 沉浸式太空展「飛奔到月球」10月2日起於K11 MUSEA開幕
zh.dek: 展覽帶領觀眾踏上38萬公里月球之旅，結合全景投影、月球居住艙設計及維港海旁戶外裝置，啟發對未來生活的想像。
body: 由IOIO Studio主辦的沉浸式太空展「飛奔到月球——38萬公里的旅行」將於10月2日至11月22日在尖沙咀K11 MUSEA舉行。
展覽以月球為核心主題，透過全景沉浸式體驗模擬飛往月球的旅程，並展示未來月球居住艙、國家級航天模型及互動設計，讓觀眾感受航天科技如何把月球變成人類下一個家園。
收費展區位於6樓室內展廳及戶外雕塑公園。星光大道、梳士巴利花園及K11 MUSEA地下則設有免費航天主題裝置，將維港海旁打造成宇宙主題公共空間。
一般門票港幣200元（12歲或以上）及175元（12歲以下），可透過Ticketflap或現場購票。開放時間為每日上午10時至晚上9時。
